svg.title: A Priest Forever
svg.desc: A one-minute comic in 5 panels. Panel 1 (Genesis 14:18-20): Melchizedek, in a wine-coloured tunic, holding out a cup of wine with loaves beside him as he blesses Abram; two bundles of spoil set down between them. Caption: "Abram returns from battle. Melchizedek, king of Salem and priest of God Most High, meets him." Melchizedek says: "Blessed be Abram by God Most High, Possessor of heaven and earth;". Note: "Genesis records no father, mother, birth or death for him." Panel 2 (Hebrews 7:23): a line of priests in white; the first is fading away. Caption: "Then the Law: priests from Levi, one after another." Hebrews says: "The former priests were many in number, because they were prevented by death from continuing in office,". Panel 3 (Psalm 110:1-4): David seated with a scroll on his knee, writing. Caption: "Later than the Law, David writes down God’s oath." David says: "The LORD has sworn and will not change his mind, “You are a priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.”" Panel 4 (Hebrews 7:24; 8:1): the risen Jesus seated at the right hand of a throne of light, at its height, gold light streaming toward Him. Caption: "Jesus, risen, seated at God’s right hand." Hebrews says: "he holds his priesthood permanently, because he continues forever." Panel 5 (Hebrews 4:16): a woman and a man kneeling in prayer at night. Caption: "So you can come to God through Him." Hebrews says: "Let us then with confidence draw near to the throne of grace,". The point: God swore that Jesus would be a priest forever, and He is: risen, seated in heaven, His one sacrifice finished. So draw near to God through Him with confidence (Hebrews 7:27, 25; 4:16).
svg.text: Melchizedek, the oath, and the priest who never dies

svg.text: God swore that Jesus would be a priest forever, and He is: risen,
seated in heaven, His one sacrifice finished. So draw near to God
Genesis does not describe Melchizedek's dress, so his colours are a fixed
choice. It records no words of Abram to him, so the comic gives him none.
